name: Can accessible bathroom modifications improve the resale value of my home?

mainEntity.name: Can accessible bathroom modifications improve the resale value of my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the primary goal of accessible modifications is functionality and safety, they can potentially add value to your home, especially if there's a growing demand for accessible features in your local market. Well-designed, aesthetically pleasing modifications that blend seamlessly with the home's style tend to be more appealing to potential buyers. However, some highly specialized modifications might have limited appeal. Consider the balance between functionality for your needs and broad appeal when making design choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessible modifications can add value, particularly if well-designed and in demand locally, but highly specialized features may have limited broad appeal.
